chunks: As for what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah, who said:
I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A woman has an erotic dream in her sleep and emits the major fluid? He said: “Ghusl is not obligatory upon her.”

key_terms.الْغُسْلُ: ritual bath required for certain states of impurity
key_terms.الْمَاءَ الْأَعْظَمَ: the major fluid referred to in the narration
key_terms.تَحْتَلِمُ: has an erotic dream during sleep

ai.seo_question: Does a woman have to perform ghusl after an erotic dream?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding ritual purity. It states that if a woman experiences a dream in sleep and emits fluid, ghusl is not obligatory upon her according to this narration.
